snippet.title: Frequency Sync // Steam Next Fest Trailer
snippet.description:
The #steamnextfest demo for Frequency Sync is out now! Check it out and wishlist today at: https://frequencysync.app/

Meta Quest Demo Coming Soon!

Frequency Sync gamify's music visualizers and dance music through complex geometric puzzles. Immerse yourself in the audio and visual experience while piecing together shattered shards of audio-visual magic!

#madewithunity #dancemusic #musicgames #quest3 #quest3gameplay #gameplay #gamedev
